title: Mount Doom and the Return of the King
range: Mount Doom and the Return of the King

questions.question: What does Frodo do at the Crack of Doom?
questions.answer: He claims the Ring for himself
choices: He claims the Ring for himself

questions.question: What does Gollum bite off to get the Ring?
questions.note: He gets the Ring back, finger and all.

questions.question: How is the Ring finally destroyed?
questions.answer: Gollum falls into the fire with it
choices: Gollum falls into the fire with it
questions.note: He fights Frodo for it on the edge and falls holding his precious.

questions.question: Who rescues Frodo and Sam from the slopes of Mount Doom?
questions.note: They wake in Minas Tirith to find Gandalf laughing.

questions.question: Who is crowned King of Gondor?
questions.note: Gandalf crowns him. 'Now come the days of the King.'

questions.question: Who does Aragorn marry?
questions.note: Elrond brings her to the coronation.

questions.question: What does Aragorn say when the hobbits bow to him?
questions.answer: My friends, you bow to no one
choices: My friends, you bow to no one
questions.note: Then the whole city bows to the four hobbits.

questions.question: Whom does Sam marry back in the Shire?
questions.note: He finally talks to her at the Green Dragon.

questions.question: From where do Frodo, Bilbo, and Gandalf sail into the West?
questions.note: Frodo gives Sam the Red Book to finish.

questions.question: What is the last line of the trilogy?
questions.note: Sam says it, home with Rosie and his children.
